// CASE prio_while_let expect=fire
func n1(_ streams: [Stream]) {
  for stream in streams {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      var iterator = stream.makeIterator()
      while let next = await iterator.next() {
        await handle(next)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE plain_while_let expect=fire
func n1b(_ streams: [Stream]) {
  for stream in streams {
    tasks.append(Task {
      var iterator = stream.makeIterator()
      while let next = await iterator.next() {
        await handle(next)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE prio_for_case_let expect=fire
func n2(_ groups: [[Int?]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      for case let value? in group {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE plain_for_case_let expect=fire
func n2b(_ groups: [[Int?]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task {
      for case let value? in group {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE prio_for_where expect=fire
func n3(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      for value in group where value > 0 {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE plain_for_where expect=fire
func n3b(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task {
      for value in group where value > 0 {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE prio_labeled expect=fire
func n4(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      inner: for value in group {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE plain_labeled expect=fire
func n4b(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task {
      inner: for value in group {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE prio_for_in_plain expect=fire
func n5(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      for value in group {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE prio_repeat expect=fire
func n6(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      var index = 0
      repeat {
        await work(group[index])
        index += 1
      } while index < group.count
    })
  }
}

// CASE prio_enumerated expect=fire
func n7(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) {
      for (offset, value) in group.enumerated() {
        await work(offset + value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE detached_prio_for_where expect=fire
func n8(_ groups: [[Int]]) {
  for group in groups {
    tasks.append(Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
      for value in group where value > 0 {
        await work(value)
      }
    })
  }
}

// CASE top_task_loop_inside expect=fire
func n9(_ ids: [Int]) {
  Task(priority: .utility) {
    for id in ids where id > 0 {
      await work(id)
    }
  }
}

// CASE top_task_loop_inside_plain expect=fire
func n9b(_ ids: [Int]) {
  Task {
    for id in ids where id > 0 {
      await work(id)
    }
  }
}
